anti_hallucination_rule: The idea gate only proves the recorded seed/input idea exists. It does not prove memories, story prose, props, environment interactions, or generated panels. Those are separate gates.

claims.claim: A seed idea exists as a recorded pipeline input.
claims.basis: story_contract.json contains seed: 'Horus and Embry have tea under a patio umbrella on a Warhammer 40k void world while Tyranids run/play in the background and they discuss SPARTA Explorer.'

claims.claim: The idea has an input contract artifact.
The idea gate proves persona memories, emotional beats, or story completeness.
claims.basis: Persona memories are Phase 2. Story completeness is Phase 3. Generated panels are later gates.
Embry Kai/Hawaii/father/garage/ToM claims depend on persona_memory/tom_edges recall, not idea provenance.
Completeness of props/characters/weather/environment interactions is a story-package gate, not idea provenance.
